sanskrit: yad devā devaheḍanaṃ devāsaś cakṛmā vayam | ādityās tasmān no yūyam ṛtasyartena muñcata ||
english: Whatever offence against the gods, O gods, we have committed — from that, O Ādityas, do you release us by the power of ṛta.

sanskrit: ṛtasyārtenādityā yajatrā muñcateha naḥ | yajñaṃ yad yajñavāhasaḥ śikṣanta upārima ||
english: By the power of ṛta, O adorable Ādityas, release us here; for though you, the bearers of the sacrifice, were willing to instruct us in sacrifice, we fell short.

sanskrit: medasvatā yajamānāḥ srucājyena juhvataḥ | akāmā viśve vo devāḥ śikṣanto nopa śekima ||
english: Offering oblation with the ladle and ghee — though all of you gods were willingly instructing us, we sacrificers rich in fat-offerings could not fully attain.

sanskrit: yad vidvāṃso yad avidvāṃsa enāṃsi cakṛmā vayam | [Bhatt. enāya tasmān na iha muñcata viśve devāḥ sajoṣasaḥ ||
english: Whatever sins we have committed knowingly or unknowingly — from that guilt, release us here, all you gods acting in concert.

sanskrit: yadi jāgrad yadi svapann ena enasyo 'karam | bhūtaṃ mā tasmād bhavyaṃ ca drupadād iva muñcatām ||
english: Whether waking or sleeping I have done wrong upon wrong — from that, both what has been and what is yet to be, may they release me, as from a wooden post.

sanskrit: drupadād iva mumucānaḥ svinnaḥ snātvā malād iva | pūtaṃ pavitreṇājyaṃ viśvān muñcantu mainasaḥ ||
english: As one released from a wooden post, as one who has sweated and bathed away impurity — let them release me, purified with the purifying ghee, from all sins.

sanskrit: yad yāmaṃ cakrur nikhananto agre kārṣīvaṇā na vido na vidyayā | vaivasvate rājani taj juhomy adhā yajñiyaṃ madhuman no astu ||
english: What a boundary the ploughmen made at the beginning by driving in stakes — without proper knowledge and without learning — that I offer into Vaivasvata the king; may our sacrificial rite now be sweet.

sanskrit: vaivasvataḥ kṛṇavad bheṣajāni madhubhāgo madhunā saṃ sṛjāti | mātur yad ena iṣitaṃ na āgan yad vā pitāparāddho jihīḍe ||
english: May Vaivasvata prepare the remedies; may he, having a share of sweetness, unite us with sweetness. Whatever sin sent by a mother has come upon us, or whatever offence a father has committed in anger — may it be healed.

sanskrit: yadīdaṃ mātur yadi vā pitur no bhrātuḥ putrād reṣata ena āgan | yāvanto asyāḥ pitaraḥ sacante teṣāṃ sarveṣāṃ śivo astu manyuḥ ||
english: If this sin has come upon us injuriously from mother, from father, from brother, or from a son — may the wrath of all those fathers who attend upon her be propitious.

sanskrit: apamityam apratītaṃ yad asmi yamasya yena balinā carāmi | idaṃ tad agne anṛṇo bhavāmi jīvann enaḥ prati dadāmi sarvam ||
english: Whatever debt remains unpaid, whatever I owe — that by which I move under Yama's authority — from this, O Agni, I become free of debt; while yet living I render back all sin.

sanskrit: ihaiva santaḥ prati dadhma etaj jīvā jīvebhyo ni harāma enat | apamitya dhānyaṃ yaj jaghāsa- -agnir mā tasmād anṛṇaṃ kṛṇotu ||
english: Even here and now, we make this return; we, the living, carry back this debt to the living. Whatever grain was consumed after being borrowed — may Agni make me free of that debt.

sanskrit: anṛṇā asminn anṛṇāḥ parasmin tṛtīye nāke anṛṇāḥ syāma | ye devayānā uta pitṛyāṇāḥ sarvān patho anṛṇāḥ kṣayema ||
english: May we be free of debt in this world, free of debt in the next, free of debt in the third vault of heaven. May we dwell free of debt on all paths — those of the gods and those of the fathers.

sanskrit: yad dhastābhyāṃ cakṛmā kilbiṣam akṣam aktum upalipsamānāḥ | ugraṃpaśye ugrajitau tad adya- -apsarasām anu dattām ṛṇaṃ naḥ ||
english: Whatever guilt we committed with our hands seeking to anoint the dice — that, O Ugraṃpaśyā and Ugrajit, you two Apsarases, grant us release from that debt today.

sanskrit: ugraṃpaśye rāṣṭrabhṛtaḥ kilbiṣaṃ yad akṣavṛttam anu dattaṃ nas tat | ṛṇān no na ṛṇam ertsamāno yamasya loke adhirajjur āyat ||
english: O Ugraṃpaśyā, sustainer of the realm, whatever guilt arising from the play of dice — grant us release from that. Let not the one seeking our debt come to us; may he arrive at Yama's world, fettered with cords.

sanskrit: yasmā ṛṇaṃ yasya jāyām upaimi yaṃ yācamāno abhyaimi devāḥ | te vācaṃ vādiṣur mottarāṃ mad devapatnī apsarasāv adhītam ||
english: Him to whom I owe a debt, whose wife I approach, whom I approach as a supplicant — O gods, may they speak no word superior to mine; O divine wives, O Apsarases, this has been pondered by you.

sanskrit: yad adīvyann aham ṛṇaṃ kṛṇomy adāsyann agna uta saṃgṛṇāmi | vaiśvānaro adhipā no vasiṣṭha ud in nayāti sukṛtasya lokam ||
english: When gambling, I incur a debt; when intending not to give, O Agni, I also make a pledge. May Vaiśvānara, our most excellent overlord, lead us upward to the world of the well-performed deed.

sanskrit: vaiśvānaraḥ pāvayā naḥ pavitrair yat saṃgaram abhidhāvāmy āśām | anājānan manasā yācamāno yat tatraino apa tat suvāmi ||
english: May Vaiśvānara purify us with purifiers, since I run toward the quarter of pledged obligation. Whatever sin is there in begging mentally without knowing — that I press away.

sanskrit: vaiśvānarāya prati vedayāma etad yad gṛṇaṃ saṃgaro devatāsu | sa etān pāśān vicṛtaṃ pra veda- -atha pakvena saha saṃ bhavema ||
english: Let us make known to Vaiśvānara this pledge of the debt that I declare among the deities; may he fully understand the unravelling of these bonds, and then may we come together with what is ripened.

sanskrit: yad antarikṣaṃ pṛthivīm uta dyāṃ yan mātaraṃ pitaraṃ vā jihiṃsima | agnir mā tasmād enaso gārhapatyaḥ pra muñcatu ||
english: Whatever harm we have done to the atmosphere, to the earth or to heaven, to mother or to father — from that sin may Agni Gārhapatya release me.

sanskrit: bhūmir mātāditir no janitraṃ bhrātāntarikṣam abhiśastyā naḥ | dyaur naḥ pitā pitryāc chaṃ bhavāti jāmim ṛtvā māva patsi lokāt ||
english: Earth is our mother, Aditi our birth-source, the atmosphere our brother against our calumny; may Father Heaven be auspicious from the ancestral realm — do not, having approached a kinswoman, fall us from the world.

sanskrit: yatrā suhārdaḥ sukṛto madanti vihāya rogaṃ tanvaḥ svāyāḥ | aśloṇā aṅgair ahrutāḥ svarge atrā paśyema pitarau ca putrān ||
english: Where the good-hearted and the well-performed rejoice, having shed the disease of their own body — whole in limb, uninjured, in heaven — there may we behold both our parents and our sons.

sanskrit: viṣāṇā pāśām̐ adhi vi ṣyatu tvad ya uttamā adhamā vāruṇā ye | yad dāruṇā badhyase yac ca rajjvā yad bhūmyāṃ badhyase yac ca vācā ||
english: May Viṣāṇā loosen and release from you all the bonds — highest, lowest, and those of Varuṇa — by which you are bound with wood, by which with rope, by which you are bound to the earth, and by which with a spoken vow.

sanskrit: udagātāṃ bhagavatī vicṛtau nāma tārake | prehāmṛtasya yacchatāṃ pra yad baddhakamocanam ||
english: The two auspicious stars named Vicṛtau have risen; may they reach here and bestow of immortality — that which releases the bound.

sanskrit: vi jihīṣva lokaṃ kṛṇu baddhān muñcāsi baddhakam | yonyā iva pracyuto garbhaḥ pathaḥ sarvām̐ anu kṣayā ||
english: Open wide, make room; you release the bound from their bonds. Like an embryo thrust forth from the womb, dwell upon all the paths.

sanskrit: taṃ prajānan prati gṛhṇātu vidvān prajāpatiḥ prathamajā ṛtasya | asmābhir dattaṃ jarasaḥ parastād acchinnaṃ tantum anu saṃ carema ||
english: Knowing him, may the wise Prajāpati, first-born of ṛta, receive him; may we follow the unbroken thread that has been given by us, beyond old age.

sanskrit: tataṃ tantum anv eke caranti yeṣāṃ dattam ayanaṃ pitryeṇa | abandhv eke dadataḥ pra yacchān dātuṃ cec chikṣān sa svarga eṣām ||
english: Some follow along the stretched thread, for whom a path has been given through ancestral rite; some, having no kin, hand on and extend — if they have learned to give, that is their heaven.

sanskrit: anvārabhethām anusaṃrabhethām etaṃ lokaṃ śraddadhānāḥ sacante | yad vāṃ pūrtaṃ praviṣṭam agnau tasya guptaye dampatī saṃ śrayethām ||
english: Take hold of it in succession, grasp it in succession; those who have faith attend upon this world. Whatever charitable deed of you two has entered the fire — for its safekeeping let the couple take refuge together.

sanskrit: devāḥ pitaraḥ pitaro devā | yo 'smi so 'smi so 'yam asmi ||
english: Gods are fathers; fathers are gods. Who I am, that I am; that one here — I am he.

sanskrit: sa pacāmi sa yajāmi sa yajate 'sya | śaṃ ma iṣṭam astu śunaṃ śāntaṃ śivaṃ kṛtaṃ tasmān mā yavam ||
english: He cooks, he sacrifices, he worships for this man. May the desired be auspicious to me; prosperous, pacified, propitious — from that keep the barley grain safe for me.

sanskrit: nāke rājan prati tiṣṭha tatraitat prati tiṣṭhatu | viddhi pūrtasya no rājan sa deva sumanā bhava ||
english: O king, stand firm in the vault of heaven; may this offering stand firm there. Know our charitable deed, O king; be well-disposed, O divine one.
